title: This Life Is Diminishing, Day And Night
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 205
summary: Seeking is carried here from this life is diminishing, day and night toward nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels searching, hungry, unsettled, because it keeps seeking inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Seeking steadies when nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the.

lines.translation: This life is diminishing, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man gur mil kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau bena(n)tee sunahu mere meetaa sa(n)t Tahal kee belaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: e'eehaa khaaT chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa ||1||
lines.translation: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: eih sa(n)saar bikaar sahase meh tario braham giaanee ||
lines.translation: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiseh jagai peeaae har ras akath kathaa tin jaanee ||2||
lines.translation: Those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this sublime essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਵਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau aae soiee vihaajhahu har gur te maneh baseraa ||
lines.translation: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoigo feraa ||3||
lines.translation: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore ||
lines.translation: O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhaas ihee sukh maagai mo kau kar sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||4||3||124||
lines.translation: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||124||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: this life is diminishing, day and night.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside this world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the.
